description:
One-shot operator-only backfill that stamps the GAP-5 idempotent-ingest `external_id` on pre-slice-1 `session_ledger__event` rows. Slice 1 added the live `external_id` derivation (the importer computes it on every NEW event) plus the `(session_id, external_id)` unique index; rows that predate the migration carry NULL `external_id`. Postgres treats NULLs as DISTINCT so they do not violate the unique, but a re-ingest of a historical event derives a non-null id that does NOT match the legacy null row — so the legacy row would duplicate. This verb stamps every legacy row with the SAME derivation the live importer uses, so historical re-ingest dedups, and so the operator can subsequently land the `external_id` NOT-NULL constraint (slice 2b).

Derivation (reproduces `importer._event_external_id` EXACTLY): `external_id = vendor_event_id` when present, else a content-addressed `derv:` sha256 over `(session_id, event_type, role, content_key, event_at_iso, ordinal)`. `content_key` = the NUL-stripped `content_text` — fetched from blob storage (via `content_blob_id`) when the row is OFFLOADED (stored `content_text` is NULL). `ordinal` = the source-order occurrence index within each `(event_type, role, content_key, event_at)` group, counted over NULL-vendor rows only and ranked by `sequence` (== original source order).

Properties. (1) Idempotent + fill-only: each pass stamps only `external_id IS NULL` rows and re-derives the same id deterministically — a re-run is a no-op once converged. Non-destructive, so no `confirm` gate. (2) Skip-and-count on a live-window collision: if a historical event was re-ingested after the slice-1 deploy, the new non-null row already owns the derived id; the legacy null row is SKIPPED (left NULL) and counted in `collisions_skipped` rather than colliding on the unique. A non-zero `collisions_skipped` flags stale null-duplicates the operator disposes of (a separate delete pass) before the slice-2b NOT-NULL can enforce. (3) Bounded memory: session-keyset paged; each session's events are read in `sequence` order to compute the ordinal.

When to use. Run once after the slice-1 unique index is live, before landing the slice-2b NOT-NULL constraint. Re-run to confirm convergence — a clean run returns `events_stamped` 0. If `collisions_skipped` is non-zero, dispose of the stale null-duplicates and re-run before NOT-NULL.

This verb is `is_discoverable=False` — the model cannot find it via process_search and never proposes it. Operator-only via the operator bridge.
embedding_description: Operator-only one-shot ledger backfill: stamp the GAP-5 external_id on pre-slice-1 __event rows so historical re-ingest dedups. Reproduces the live importer derivation (vendor_event_id or a content-addressed derv: sha256 over session/type/role/content_key/event_at/ordinal), fetching offloaded blob content for the content_key. Idempotent fill-NULL (no confirm gate), session-keyset paged, skip-and-count on a live-window collision. Gates the slice-2b external_id NOT-NULL. Returns sessions_scanned + events_stamped + collisions_skipped.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Backfill counts. `sessions_scanned` is the number of `__session` rows visited (id-keyset paged); `events_stamped` is the number of `__event` rows whose NULL `external_id` was stamped this run (0 on a converged ledger — re-run to confirm completeness); `collisions_skipped` is the number of legacy null rows whose derived id already belonged to a live-window duplicate (left NULL for the operator to dispose of before the slice-2b NOT-NULL).
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Re-run this verb to confirm `events_stamped` is 0 (converged). If `collisions_skipped` is non-zero, quiesce ingestion, dispose of the stale null-duplicate rows (the live row with that external_id is canonical), and re-run before landing the slice-2b `external_id` NOT-NULL constraint.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Session-keyset pass over `__session`; per session, reads the events ordered by `sequence`, derives each null-`external_id` row's id (reproducing the live importer derivation, fetching offloaded blob content), and predicated-updates the row where `external_id IS NULL`.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: LedgerRepositoryError: a row had a non-datetime/str `event_at` (NOT-NULL TIMESTAMP anomaly), or the underlying state_service / blob_storage_service rejected a read/UPDATE. BlobAdapterError: an offloaded row's blob could not be retrieved or decoded. Possible causes: schema not yet adopted, a missing blob, state_service unavailable.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: Confirm the slice-1 schema (the `external_id` column + the `(session_id, external_id)` unique index) is adopted. For a missing-blob error, investigate the offending `content_blob_id` via the blob storage tooling. The backfill is idempotent, so a re-run after fixing the anomaly resumes cleanly (already-stamped rows are skipped).
